acceptance: writeFileNoFollow with exclusive: false writes to a sibling temporary file with O_NOFOLLOW/O_EXCL and renames it into place so existing files (.gitignore, .adlc/config.json) are never truncated in-place
if the write fails mid-flight, the temporary file is cleaned up and the pre-existing file remains intact
title: init: rewrite existing .gitignore atomically via temp file + rename (#668)
